basic_info.title: Curriculum Learning for Reinforcement Learning Domains: A Framework and Survey

method.notes: Canonical framework/survey for sequencing tasks or data into curricula when the target task is too hard to learn directly. Grounds this project's staged pipeline (stage0/stage1 self-supervised pretrain -> stage2r WM -> optional stage3 actor) and the L=16->64 sequence-length curriculum as established practice rather than ad-hoc choices.

gap_analysis.novelty_reasoning: Cited to situate the project's staged/curriculum training in established literature.
